name: Professional Scrum Master III
name_ja: プロフェッショナル・スクラムマスター III

logistics.format: Online assessment with mix of multiple-choice and free-form essay questions on real-world scenarios; passing score 85%

formal: Recommended: hold PSM I and PSM II; deep practical Scrum mastery required to pass

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: The recorded five-year profile and scenario essays support professional Scrum leadership and judgment; subjective assessment and non-security scope do not establish expert security-program direction.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Free-form scenario essays and a five-year profile support professional Scrum judgment beyond objective-question familiarity. No verified leadership portfolio is recorded, so pinnacle status and rarity alone do not establish expert organizational direction.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded five-year profile and real-world essay scenarios provide more substantive evidence of practitioner judgment. They support professional delivery-method expertise, without establishing expert cybersecurity leadership.
